snippet.title: Videogamedunkey playing Bulbo's Belief System!
snippet.description:
This is a video of videogamedunkey playing Bulbo's Belief System live.

The game won the Unbelievable Award at the Bigmode Game Jam '25

You can play the game here:
https://abstractsven.itch.io/bulbos-belief-system

Wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549280/Bulbos_Belief_System/
